messages:
anika: Heads-up I opened a PR to add a 'fallback-friendly' column to the model catalog compatibility matrix and to include concrete SDK v4 examples for variant fallbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9241

omar: Great. Can we show an explicit example for a long-context model where fallback is disabled (because of KV-cache sensitivity)? That keeps folks from accidentally enabling fallback in prod.

anika: yep — plan is to mark models with `fallback-friendly: yes|no` and a short rationale string. For long-context models we'll add `no — KV-cache/seq-ceiling sensitive`. Also adding a short YAML snippet for model-card metadata so ops teams can see the source of truth.

tegan: please include the SDK snippet for how to opt a request out of fallback at call time (some customers want per-request control).

anika: added both: a global model-card flag and `allow_fallback: false` option in the SDK call. Snippet below from the PR: 

```js
// per-request opt-out example (SDK v4)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

await client.generate({
  model: 'vega13b@2026-11-01',
  input: 'Explain the KV-cache behavior during long-context generation',
  options: { max_tokens: 300 },
  routing: { allow_fallback: false } // opt-out for this call
});
```

omar: nice. also add a tiny example of explicit fallback weights (latency vs cost). We've seen teams want to prefer cost in background jobs.

anika: added `fallback_strategy` example: `latency-first` and `cost-first` plus a note that runtime may still abide by pool-level policies.

runtime-ci: automated check: PR #9241 — verifying matrix schema change, model card YAML lint, and snippet examples.

runtime-ci: matrix schema change OK (added column header). YAML lint: 1 warning in artifacts/vega13b-card.yaml -> `compatibility.seq_ceiling` missing but not fatal.

anika: fixed YAML in PR to add `compatibility.seq_ceiling` and included a short note about measured impact on P95 when using q4 variants. Pasted a CSV excerpt into the PR for transparency.

tegan: small wording nit — change "fallback-friendly" to "fallback_capable" in the matrix? It's slightly clearer semantically.

anika: hmm ok. I'll rename the column in the PR. That will be a non-breaking docs-only change but we should coordinate with any tooling reading the CSV. runtime-ci: any concerns?

runtime-ci: docs-only rename fine. No infra dependencies detected. Recommend adding a short line in the model-registry doc about the naming convention.

omar: we should also call out metric implications — fallback increases per-route token-cost variance and can make attribution harder for committed Dedicated pools. Add a note linking to console docs.

anika: added a one-sentence note and link to Console cost breakdown. Also added guidance: for Dedicated pools, prefer model alias pinning over fallback where strict SLOs apply.

tegan: can you paste the final model-card YAML snippet you added? I want to mirror it in the migration guide.

anika: pasted snippet in PR body: 

```yaml
# model card metadata additions (YAML)
variant_labels:
  - name: artemis13b
    variants: [artemis13b-q4, artemis13b-q2, artemis13b-cpu]
compatibility:
  fallback_capable: yes
  seq_ceiling: 2048
  notes: "q4 variant has reduced long-seq throughput; use with KV-cache disabled for long-context use cases"
```

omar: perfect. One more request: can docs-bot run the link checker and snippet linter? We need to ensure the JS snippet runs under SDK v4 lint rules.

docs-bot: Running link-check and snippet-lint on PR #9241. Snippet-lint: found missing semicolon in example line 3. Link-check: all links are 200.

anika: fixed semicolon and pushed.

tegan: QA ask — can someone run the snippet against staging runtime with a pinned model and a fallback assertion? I want to see logs showing fallback activation so we can screenshot for the guide.

omar: I'll run it later today and paste logs here. Quick sanity check: when fallback triggers, runtime emits an event `routing.fallback_used` with metadata {from: primary, to: variant, reason}. We should include that in the docs.

anika: added a small note and example log line in the PR: `routing.fallback_used from=artemis13b to=artemis13b-q4 reason=capacity`

runtime-ci: smoke test requested. Scheduling a canary request run against staging.

runtime-ci: smoke result: fallback path exercised successfully; emitted event `routing.fallback_used`. Included truncated log in CI artifacts.

om ar: (typo) oops meant to be 'omar' — LGTM on content.

tegan: LGTM too. Two minor editorial nits left (wording in matrix header and an extra Oxford comma).

anika: fixed editorial nits. Ready to merge after docs-bot checks.

docs-bot: final checks passed. PR #9241 merged.

anika: thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) tegan to update migration guide with per-request opt-out example, 2) omar to run a quick sweep of long-context model cards and add `seq_ceiling` where missing, 3) ops to consider documentation for pool-level fallback policies. I'll add cards to the docs board.

omar: filing sweep task now.

tegan: will draft migration guide updates tomorrow.

anika: closing thread. If anyone sees a regression or confusion from the change, open a docs follow-up or ping #eng-runtime.
